sources.title: Gemma 4 — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models undergo the same rigorous infrastructure security protocols as our proprietary models. By choosing Gemma 4, enterprises and sovereign organizations gain a trusted, transparent foundation that delivers state-of-the-art capabilities while meeting the highest standards for security and reliability.

sources.title: Gemma 4 model card | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 models were developed in partnership with internal safety and responsible AI teams. A range of automated as well as human evaluations were conducted to help improve model safety.

sources.title: Gemma 4 model overview - Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of generative artificial intelligence models and you can use them in a wide variety of generation tasks, including question answering, summarization, and reasoning. Gemma models are provided with open weights and permit responsible commercial use, allowing you to tune and deploy them in your own projects and applications.
